name: nexusplus
description:
Most people's contacts are scattered: a name spelled one way in Outlook, a phone number that only ever made it into iCloud, a company that changed three jobs ago but still shows as current. Nexusplus combines those pieces into one explainable record per person, shows where each detail came from, and flags a likely duplicate for your review rather than merging two people who merely share an address or an office line.

Connect Nexusplus to ChatGPT and you can ask about your contacts in plain language, "who do I know at Acme," "what's Sheila's current number," "have I already added this person", and, when you choose, have it act on your behalf: capturing a brand-new contact the moment you meet them, with a note on why ("met at a conference," "a competitor," "a candidate"), flagging a likely duplicate for you to review, or adding a new email or phone number to someone you already know. Every change it makes is recorded in the contact's version history. By default, a contact the assistant adds or edits is published right away to the connected accounts that accept it; a list can be set to hold the assistant's changes for your review instead. Publishing sends the contact to every connected Outlook or iCloud account that accepts it, unless you designate specific destinations for it, and it updates the record already in those accounts.

defaultPrompt: What contact lists do I have?
Show me likely duplicate contacts to review.
